clue.text: Youth finds benefit in climbing

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the other piece here

parts.note: climbing is an ascent
the dole is British slang for unemployment benefit

explanation.surface: A young person discovers some advantage in going rock climbing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Benefit' looks like an advantage gained; here it is the British slang word for state unemployment pay.
explanation.definitionFit: A teenager in the years between childhood and adulthood is a youth.

clue.text: Campaigner is less prepared when touring South Africa

indicators.note: touring means going round, so one piece goes round another here

parts.note: cruder means rougher, less refined or prepared

explanation.surface: An activist turns out to be less ready while travelling around South Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: A crusader is someone who campaigns energetically for a cause, a synonym.

clue.text: Horse in river causes worry

indicators.note: in puts the horse piece inside the river piece

parts.note: the Nile is the great river of Egypt
gee-gee, GG, is a childish word for a horse

explanation.surface: A horse wading into a river gives its owner some anxiety.
explanation.definitionFit: A niggle is a small nagging worry or doubt, a synonym.

clue.text: Fever is universal in advancing years

indicators.note: in puts the universal piece inside the years piece

parts.note: advancing years are old age
U is the film certificate abbreviation for universal

explanation.surface: Fever is common to everyone as they grow old.
explanation.definitionFit: Ague is an old word for a malarial fever with shivering fits.

clue.text: Bill arrests staff of delivery supervisor

indicators.note: arrests means holds or captures, so one piece holds the other inside

parts.note: a bill is a poster stuck up on a wall
a staff is a pole, like a mast

explanation.surface: A bill leads to the detention of some workers.
explanation.definitionFit: A postmaster runs a post office, overseeing the delivery of mail.

clue.text: Magazine prepared in class

indicators.note: in places the prepared piece inside the class piece

parts.note: a caste is a social class
set means ready or prepared

explanation.surface: A periodical is got ready during a lesson.
explanation.definitionFit: A magazine is a cartridge holding film or tape, as a cassette does.

clue.text: Jolly king lying in state

indicators.note: lying in means resting inside, so the king piece sits inside the state

parts.note: Maine is a US state
R is the abbreviation for rex, king

explanation.surface: A cheerful monarch lies in state after his death.
explanation.walkthrough: Jolly is old naval slang for a Royal Marine; 'lying in state' looks like a funeral but splits into an indicator and a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: Jolly is slang for a Royal Marine, a sea soldier.

clue.text: Speak about sinister murder

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: to say is to speak
sinister is Latin for left, abbreviated L

explanation.surface: Someone talks about a dark killing.
explanation.definitionFit: To slay is to kill, a synonym of murder used as a verb.

clue.text: Operas at Bayreuth occasion bold action

parts.note: Der Ring (des Nibelungen) is Wagner's opera cycle staged at Bayreuth
a do is a party or occasion

explanation.surface: An evening at the Wagner festival provides a heroic moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Derring-do means daring, heroic action, an old literary phrase.

clue.text: Use a disguise we're told

indicators.note: we're told points to something heard, a sound-alike

parts.note: a veil is something that disguises

explanation.surface: Someone is advised to wear a disguise.
explanation.definitionFit: Avail as a noun means use or benefit, as in to no avail.

clue.text: Slump in alley from filling food

indicators.note: in puts the slump piece inside the alley piece

parts.note: an alley is a narrow lane
to sag is to slump

explanation.surface: Someone collapses in a back street after a heavy meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Lasagne is a substantial pasta dish, so a filling food.

clue.text: Declare to being cross about condition

indicators.note: about means around, so the cross piece goes around the condition

parts.note: testy means irritable or cross
if introduces a condition

explanation.surface: Someone states they are annoyed about some situation.
explanation.definitionFit: To testify is to declare something as evidence, a synonym.

clue.text: Small border plant

parts.note: an edge is a border

explanation.surface: A little plant grows at the edge of a garden.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedge is a grass-like plant of wet places, an example of a plant.

clue.text: A time to retain some servants in the home

indicators.note: to retain means to keep within, so one pair holds the other

parts.note: part means some
men can mean servants, as in men and maids

explanation.surface: It is time to keep on a few household staff.
explanation.definitionFit: An apartment is a flat, a self-contained home.

clue.text: Revulsion to constituents of Anchor beer

indicators.note: constituents of means the letters are the raw parts to be rebuilt

explanation.surface: A drinker is disgusted by what goes into a particular beer.
explanation.walkthrough: Anchor is a brand of beer; its letters with BEER are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Abhorrence is strong disgust or loathing, a synonym of revulsion.

clue.text: Leicester footballers listen for fish

parts.note: Leicester Tigers is a rugby football club
hark means listen

explanation.surface: Fans of a Leicester team are told to listen out for fish.
explanation.walkthrough: Leicester Tigers are a famous English rugby union club; rugby is a code of football.
explanation.definitionFit: The tiger shark is a large striped shark, an example of a fish.

clue.text: Treating the rash wrongly is fateful

indicators.note: wrongly says these letters are wrongly ordered and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: Misdiagnosing a skin complaint has grave consequences.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth-shattering means momentous, of huge consequence, like fateful.

clue.text: Hospital superior inflames election proceedings

parts.note: U means upper class or superior
stings means inflames or smarts

explanation.surface: A senior doctor irritates patients.
explanation.definitionFit: The hustings are the campaign meetings and speeches before an election.

clue.text: Suggestion for objective in union amalgamation

indicators.note: in puts the objective inside the rearranged letters
amalgamation means blending, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: an end is an objective

explanation.surface: A hint about a goal during merger talks between unions.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a merger of trade unions; 'amalgamation' rearranges that word to INNUO, which 'in' then opens to take the goal.
explanation.definitionFit: An innuendo is an indirect, often sly suggestion or hint.

clue.text: Possibly rue arrest of man on board

indicators.note: possibly signals that these letters could be put another way

explanation.surface: Someone may come to regret being arrested.
explanation.definitionFit: A treasurer is an officer who sits on a board, handling finances.

clue.text: Protect college from criticism

indicators.note: from means taken away from, so a letter goes

parts.note: censure is severe criticism

explanation.surface: Shield the university from attacks.
explanation.definitionFit: To ensure is to make safe or secure, so to protect.

clue.text: Champion releases arrow ending just outside the bull

indicators.note: releases means lets go of, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: a champion is a winner

indicators.note: ending picks out the final letter of arrow

explanation.surface: An archer lets fly, landing just beside the centre of the target.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as archery, and the definition is the ring in a target next to the bullseye.
explanation.definitionFit: The inner is the ring on a target immediately around the bullseye.

clue.text: Supplier is the plaintiff

parts.note: a plaintiff sues, so is a suer

explanation.surface: The person bringing the lawsuit turns out to be the vendor.
explanation.definitionFit: An issuer gives out or supplies something, such as shares or tickets.

clue.text: Hand round seasoning in nursing home

parts.note: O is round in shape
spice is seasoning

explanation.surface: A carer passes the condiments round at a care home.
explanation.definitionFit: A hospice is a home caring for the terminally ill, a kind of nursing home.

clue.text: Fastening some marsh asphodel

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some bog lily is used for tying things together.
explanation.definitionFit: A hasp is a hinged metal clasp used for fastening a door or lid.

clue.text: Pray to live and follow the church

parts.note: to be is to live or exist
to see is to follow or understand
CH is the abbreviation for church

explanation.surface: Worshippers are urged to lead a good life and obey the church.
explanation.definitionFit: To beseech someone is to beg or implore them, as one prays to a god.

clue.text: Roll onto a bit of kipper in bed

parts.note: a bun is a bread roll

indicators.note: a bit of takes only the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A bread roll is topped with smoked fish for breakfast in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: A kipper is a smoked herring, a British breakfast dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A bunk is a narrow bed, often one of a stacked pair.

clue.text: Knight leaves spa for shoot

indicators.note: leaves means departs, so a letter is taken out

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring
N is the chess abbreviation for knight

explanation.surface: A knight quits a health resort to go hunting.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprig is a small shoot or twig of a plant.

clue.text: Tory-loving adversary

parts.note: Con is short for Conservative, a Tory
tender means loving or affectionate

explanation.surface: An opponent who is fond of the Conservatives.
explanation.definitionFit: A contender is a rival competitor, so an adversary.
